[Switchboard] 2026 feeds split: maximalist-playful vs stripped-down-unproduced

Angle (hot-take-then-caveat): Sept 2026 platforms reward creator-led, authentic, lower-follower voices with high trust over polished/automated content; the feed pulls between maximalist play and cozy unproduced. — framed for Online-native people who follow trends and enjoy sharp, kind humor about tech and culture. in a playful, irreverent, fast, self-aware voice.
